anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Witte p.96 lines 10–11 unrestored; apparatus L. ca. 6 Z. Dots kept as printed.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.
pass_a_gloss: And so a beginning of months has come to be for them. And it is worth setting the mind on [gap] the beginning and the first [gap], but This month is beginning of months for you; it is first in the months of the year.
pass_b_english: And so a beginning of months has come to be for them. And we should attend to [lacuna] the beginning and the first [lacuna], but "This month is a beginning of months for you; it is first among the months of the year." (Exodus 12:2)
source_text: Καὶ [ο]ὕτως ἀ[ρχὴ μηνῶ]ν αὐτοῖς [γ]έγον[εν· ἄξιον] δὲ ἐπιστῆσαι π ... νος σημαι[ν ... τὴν ἀρ]χὴν καὶ τὸ π[ρῶτον ... ]ει ἢ ε ... τε ... ται τι.. μηνον, [ἀλ]λὰ "[Ὁ μ]ὴν [ο]ὗ[τος ἀρχὴ] μηνῶν [ὑμ]ῖν, π[ρῶτός ἐστι]ν ἐν τοῖς [μησ]ὶν τ[οῦ ἐνιαυτο]ῦ".
